pages.text: Rain had been pouring down all morning. Raindrops made bubbles in the alley puddles.
Grandma next door was waiting for her breakfast bread. "I'll take it to her, even in the rain."
Mr. Pig arrived with a huge umbrella. "The biggest umbrella can handle anything!"
The umbrella opened like a roof over Coco. They walked side by side.
But the alley grew narrower and narrower. In the back alleys of Paris, the walls are close together.
Stuck! The umbrella wedged between the walls. Mr. Pig pushed, but it wouldn't budge.
He was trapped under the umbrella. He couldn't go forward or backward.
Coco looked at the roof edges. They stuck out over the alley. These were the eaves. One stretch of eaves led to the next.
Coco pattered along under the eaves. The basket didn't get wet at all.
Grandma received dry bread. In the middle of the alley, the umbrella was stuck like a roof. Mr. Pig stood dry underneath it. "It's nice here!"
